title: Matná TX zlatá s frézovaným čelem

notes: Geometry and surface use this exact actual front photograph and the same reviewed ellipse; source-specific spoke phase and rim scale are preserved.

Each front aperture is individually outlined on this photograph. Visible dark rear-barrel bands within one front aperture are removed together with its background window, not turned into a front plate.
Individually observed small openings and lug bores are retained; opaque painted root fields, branding and metal reflections stay solid.
Rear-barrel occlusion makes some perimeter boundaries locally approximate; the supplier technical image corroborates open topology, not a generic spoke substitute.
Depth, concavity and unseen rear construction remain approximate; this is image reconstruction, not manufacturing CAD.

visualReview.observedFace: Seven angular Y spokes with fourteen rim connections, seven large pentagonal main windows and seven smaller peripheral windows. Five mounting bores are independent of the spoke symmetry.
